title: Trump Fights Court Order Protecting Fed Governor Cook’s Seat Ahead of Rate Cut Decision
summary: President Trump is challenging a federal court injunction that prevents him from removing Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook, filing appeals arguing his "for cause" removal power extends beyond misconduct committed while in office as the legal battle intensifies with economists expecting a 25 basis-point rate cut on September 17.
